# Mariusz Ciupa — Scuba Diving Instructor (SSI)

> Independent SSI Divemaster Instructor (XR) offering personal, one-to-one scuba diving training. Based in the UK (London), also teaching in Lanzarote and Poland. Courses run from first-time try dives through Open Water, Advanced and speciality courses to technical diving (SSI Extended Range) and the SSI Divemaster professional program. Training is available in English and Polish.

All diving federations are accepted — divers certified with PADI or other agencies can continue training here.

## Courses (English)

- [Try Scuba](https://scubadivinginstructor.co.uk/en/beginner/try-scuba/): pool-based introductory dive experience, no certification, from age 8.
- [Open Water Diver](https://scubadivinginstructor.co.uk/en/beginner/open-water-diver/): entry-level certification course (SSI, equivalent to PADI Open Water, ISO 24801-2).
- [Advanced Open Water Diver](https://scubadivinginstructor.co.uk/en/beginner/advanced-open-water-diver/): five specialty dives, deep and navigation required, to 30 metres.
- [Speciality courses](https://scubadivinginstructor.co.uk/en/speciality/): night diving, wreck diving and other specialities.
- [Technical diving / Extended Range](https://scubadivinginstructor.co.uk/en/technical/extended-range/): planned decompression diving to 45 metres.
- [Divemaster](https://scubadivinginstructor.co.uk/en/divemaster/): SSI professional-level program (Dive Guide + Science of Diving).
